monthly = monthly.sort_values(['property_type', 'month'])
monthly['cumulative_sold'] = monthly.groupby('property_type')['sold_count'].cumsum()
fig = px.area(monthly, x='month', y='cumulative_sold', color='property_type', title='Cumulative Sold Count by Property Type Over Months', labels={'month': 'Month', 'cumulative_sold': 'Cumulative Sold Count', 'property_type': 'Property Type'})
